profile.name: Ishaan Meena
profile.headline: Computer Science @ University of Alberta · Co-op Researcher in Computer Vision & ML at Huawei
profile.summary: Computer Science student at the University of Alberta working across machine learning research and full-stack engineering. Currently a co-op researcher at Huawei Technologies Canada building feed-forward 3D scene reconstruction in PyTorch; previously built an LLM-powered Graph-RAG interface for BIM digital twins and shipped a production project-management platform with Next.js and Supabase.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

experience.role: Co-op Researcher, Computer Vision and Machine Learning
bullets: Developed a state-of-the-art feed-forward 3D scene reconstruction system in PyTorch that generates object-level meshes and 3D layouts from posed multi-view images, achieving SOTA performance against adjacent methods.

Designed a visibility- and occlusion-aware geometry-completion architecture combining Transformers, 3D CNNs, cross-view evidence and generative 3D priors; reduced Scene CD by 31.5% and Scene CD-S by 36.8%, while improving Scene F-score by 3.67 points over the matched non-occlusion ablation.

Built reproducible preprocessing, training, benchmarking and ablation pipelines spanning ground-truth and predicted-mask settings; evaluated recent 3D reconstruction methods and analyzed 156 scenes to isolate failures in segmentation, object layout and shape completion.

Preparing an ICLR 2027 paper and accompanying research codebase, translating literature reviews and quantitative failure analysis into novel architectural contributions, and presenting findings through weekly and monthly research reviews.

Developed an LLM-powered natural-language interface for BIM digital twins, combining Text-to-SQL and Graph-RAG-based information retrieval for multi-hop spatial reasoning and entity-centric question answering.
Produced research-style evaluations analyzing accuracy, failure modes and graph traversal behavior.

Developed a full-stack project management system using Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM, Supabase and Vercel, streamlining workflow for 250+ annual projects and reducing manual tracking errors by ~40%.

Implemented secure authentication, role-based access control, time tracking, payroll exports (Excel/PDF), budget/KPI dashboards and real-time team workload monitoring, enabling leads and admins to manage 50+ concurrent projects efficiently.

Designed and deployed data migration pipelines, Gantt-based project scheduling and KPI reporting APIs, maintaining historical records from 2016 onward and improving decision-making speed and accuracy by ~35% for management.

projects.title: Diffusion & Flow Matching on CIFAR-10
projects.description: Latent-space DDPM and a Flow Matching model with time-embedded UNets, trained on 50k CIFAR-10 images.
details: Built and trained a latent-space DDPM using a fully connected autoencoder and time-embedded UNet on 50k CIFAR-10 images, implementing full forward and reverse diffusion; generated samples meeting expected benchmark quality (IS 1.5–2, FID 300–350).
Implemented a Flow Matching model with a time-embedded UNet and ODE-based reverse sampling.
